{{Top|leg}}
The '''Interstellar Stock Exchange''', or '''ISE''' was the primary stock exchange in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

It was suspended on the news of the declaration of martial law in the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].
